title: Opportunistic Manipulation
ruleText: You may reveal this at the start of your Strategic Phase. Receive 1 VP for each of the following: • There is an enemy not in the Dead State in the enemy Deployment Zone. • There is an enemy not in the Dead State on your half of the field. • There is an ally in the Incapacitated State on the enemy half of the field.

title: Assassination Contract
ruleText: Receive 3 VP for killing an enemy Leader (rendering it Dead).

title: Virtuous Commander
ruleText: Receive 1 VP (to a maximum of 3 VP) for each of your models that is Alive at the end of the game.

title: Martial Valor
ruleText: Reveal this when your model Incapacitates an enemy model that costs more Recruitment Points; receive 2 VP. If another of your models Incapacitates a model that costs more RP, score an additional 1 VP.

title: No Quarter
ruleText: Receive 1 VP for every Dead enemy model at the end of the game (to a maximum of 3 VP).

title: Stand Your Ground
ruleText: Reveal this Scheme during your Strategic Phase and discard it at the start of your next Strategic Phase. Receive 1 VP (to a maximum of 3 VP) for each model that did not move this round.

title: Fierce as Fire, Immovable as a Mountain
ruleText: Reveal this card when one of your models first Wounds an enemy model in Reaction. Place a token on this card. When your model Wounds an enemy model in Reaction, place another token on this card. Score 1 VP for every token on this card (maximum of 3 VP).

title: Stalwart Defender
ruleText: Receive 3 VP if there are no enemy models in your Deployment Zone at the end of the game.

title: Blood for Blood
ruleText: Reveal this Scheme during your Strategic Phase and discard it during the End Phase; select one of your models that suffered a Wound from an enemy model. Receive 3 VP if you Incapacitate the enemy model that wounded your selected model this turn.

title: Peacekeeping Paragon
ruleText: Receive 1 VP for each enemy model that is Alive at the end of the game (to a maximum of 3 VP).

title: Pursuit of Glory
ruleText: Reveal this Scheme during your Strategic Phase and discard it during the End Phase. Receive 1 VP (to the max of 3 VP) during the end Phase of that turn for every Alive party member outside the Awareness of other party members.
